title: 邯郸冬至夜思家
titleEn: Thinking of Home on Winter Solstice Night in Handan
author: 白居易
intro: Alone at an inn on a family holiday, the poet hugs his knees by the lamp — and imagines his family at home, staying up late and talking about him.
analysis: 冬至在唐代是很重要的节日，家家团聚。白居易这时却一个人住在邯郸的驿站里。前两句写自己：抱着膝盖坐在灯前，只有影子陪着身体——“影伴身”三个字，把孤单写得具体又可怜。后两句不写自己怎么想家，反过来想象家里：家人今晚一定也坐到深夜，还在念叨着我这个出远门的人吧。这种写法叫“对面落笔”：明明是自己想家，却写家人想自己，思念就变成了双向的，更深一层。杜甫的《月夜》、王维的“遥知兄弟登高处”都用了这种手法。语言平白如话，感情却很真。
analysisEn: In the Tang dynasty, the winter solstice was a major holiday when families gathered. Bai Juyi spent it alone at a government inn in Handan. The first two lines are about himself: he sits by the lamp hugging his knees, with only his shadow for company. 影伴身, “the shadow keeps the body company”, makes the loneliness concrete and a little pitiful. The last two lines don’t describe his homesickness at all. Instead he imagines the scene at home: tonight his family must also be sitting up late — and surely they are talking about the one who is far away. This technique is called “writing from the other side” (对面落笔): instead of saying “I miss them”, the poet pictures them missing him, so the longing runs both ways and feels deeper. Du Fu and Wang Wei used the same move in famous poems. The words are as plain as speech, but the feeling is completely real — anyone who has spent a holiday away from home will recognise it.
background: Bai Juyi (772–846) wrote this in 804, aged about 32, while travelling on official business as a junior court official. Handan, in today’s Hebei, was a stop on the road east from Chang’an.
pronunciation: 邯郸 hán dān；驿 yì；膝 xī；还应 hái（还，仍然）；说着 zhe；远行人 xíng。
version: 采用通行本，与维基文库（《全唐诗》）一致。题中“冬至”一作“至除”。

lines.py: hán dān yì lǐ féng dōng zhì
lines.lit: In the Handan post station I meet the winter solstice;
lines.en: At the inn in Handan, the winter solstice comes;

lines.py: bào xī dēng qián yǐng bàn shēn
lines.lit: hugging my knees before the lamp, my shadow keeps my body company.
lines.en: I hug my knees by the lamp, my shadow my only friend.

lines.py: xiǎng dé jiā zhōng yè shēn zuò
lines.lit: I imagine at home they sit late into the night,
lines.en: At home, I think, they are sitting up late tonight,

lines.py: hái yīng shuō zhe yuǎn xíng rén
lines.lit: and surely are still talking of the one who travels far.
lines.en: and surely they are talking about the one who’s far away.

words.en: Handan, a city in today’s Hebei

words.note: 古代供官员和送信人住宿换马的地方，现代汉语“驿站”。
现代汉语“每逢佳节”“相逢”还用。
二十四节气之一，今天北方冬至吃饺子、南方吃汤圆。
古义，现代汉语说“想来”“估计”。

words.en: the one who has gone far away
words.note: 现代汉语说“出远门的人”。

imagery.name: 灯
imagery.zh: 孤灯下抱膝而坐，灯光照出一个人在外过节的冷清。
imagery.en: Sitting alone by the lamp on a holiday night — the lamplight shows how empty the evening is.
